title: Quasi-coherent closure for the canonical derived tensor
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let E,F be objects of D(O_X) with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category]. Their tensor E\otimes^L F, using the canonical K-flat derived tensor monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], has quasi-coherent cohomology.

proof.text: Use essential surjectivity of DerivedCategory.Q to choose complexes M and N representing E and F. Apply CochainComplex.exists_isKFlatResolution to M, obtaining a K-flat complex P and a quasi-isomorphism f:P→M. Localization turns f into an isomorphism Q(P)≅E. Transport the given quasi-coherent cohomology of E and F along these representing isomorphisms, using the homology functors and isomorphism-invariance of quasi-coherence.

Apply kFlat_derivedTensor_comparison_natIso to the constant functors at P and N from the one-object discrete category. Its component identifies Q(P) tensor-derived Q(N) with Q(Tot(P tensor N)), for the recorded canonical derived monoidal structure. Compose with the tensor of the representing isomorphisms to identify E tensor-derived F with that quotient.

Apply the tensor clause of derivedPullback_tensor_preserve_QCoh with the identity morphism of X to P and N. For every integer degree, map the inverse tensor comparison through the homology functor and transport quasi-coherence of the total tensor quotient to E tensor-derived F.

Derived tensor product of quasi coherent complexes has quasi coherent cohomology; derived pullback of perfect complexes is perfect
